deduplicate: one actual article per date unless already distinct original articles; compare IDs/topics/DOIs; never duplicate existing registry entries; draft IDs also count as existing work, avoid another draft for the same slot
recovery: First inspect published main + draft branch + backlog and recover failed text commits or visual review packages while preserving IDs. Do not hold future new-text drafting hostage to pending user visual approval. Missing dates become draft slots without false publishedAt; release date separately recorded at actual approval+publication.

research.featuredEarliestPublic: previous 12 months from actual work day; check epub/online/preprint, never late print issue
excluded: electrical stimulation including electrical dry needling
research.mixedReviews: inspect trial tables; do not treat electrical DN under DN node as manual DN; exclude unless separable allowed comparison
research.avoidRepeat: compare DOI evidence ledger and actual prior articles; reuse only meaningful updates

missingFields: not reported in the accessible abstract; full text needed
grading: formal GRADE/RoB only when authors actually performed it; editor judgement separately; association is not diagnostic accuracy
patientReturn: after each major evidence block, what changed/unchanged/next action
anatomy: mandatory realistic 3D virtual anatomy/dissection; bone/tendon/ligament/muscle/deep structures/nerve/vessel and relative depth as relevant; verify leaders and orientation, repair errors before publication; no flat cartoon anatomy
examVisual: accurate patient/clinician position, hand placement, direction, supportive and lowering finding, safety; do not label weak tests as confirmation
needlingSafety: 압통점은 통증 단서이지 안전한 자침 경로가 아니다. Anatomy is location understanding, not needling guidance. No blind deep directions, angle/depth/trajectory or danger structure penetration.
html: Text-first draft HTML in editorial-drafts is complete and standalone without unapproved <figure> references. Final main article embeds ONLY approved figure.brief-figure close to corresponding paragraph with clickable full resolution, Korean caption, mobile compatible tables, and source links.
assets: Candidate visuals under editorial-drafts/drafts/<id>/visuals; only user-approved binary files copied to main/assets/briefs/ with unique dated/topic names and exact src/href checks; prefer accurate 3D virtual anatomy, not cartoons.
publish: GATE: user explicitly approves all required visual candidates and release scope (never inferred)
copy the approved draft manuscript and only approved visuals from editorial-drafts to main
upload actual approved binary blobs and verify sizes/source rights
embed near relevant paragraph and update article fragment/registry
bump sw.js cache version and CORE article/approved image paths
commit exact approved release to main
verify Pages deployment for main commit, live article, all approved image HTTP 200, cache version
mark published and report live link ONLY after verification
failure: No preview approval -> retain draft and review queue, never public text-only fallback. Broken figure or failed binary -> revise/retry in draft, no release. Approved release deployment failures -> preserve package and retry next run; never silently drop visuals or claim success.

automation.dailyTask: finish and commit text draft, plan/generate visual review assets separately, report approval queue; release only on a separate explicit approval

successClaim: Draft saved means committed+read-back on editorial-drafts, NOT publicly released. Public site published requires explicit user approval and actual main deploy + live HTTPS verification. If unavailable, accurately report the last successful step.
statusFields: text draft id/commit/branch and read-back verification
visual plan/candidate ids/review statuses and pending approvals
user approval scope and timestamp if any
main article/registry/cache updated only after approval
main commit and Pages exact revision state (only if released)
live link and HTTPS image checks (only if released)
publicationMode: user-approved-visuals-gated; text stored in non-deployment GitHub draft branch; final public site only after approval

branches.caution: This repository is public. Draft branch contents are not served by GitHub Pages but are visible through GitHub; never describe them as private or confidential.

stage1_text.gate: Automatically research, fact-check, and finish the clinical manuscript FIRST. Commit only to editorial-drafts branch, preserving stable ID/date, evidence, and sources.
restrictions: Do NOT touch main article fragments, articles.json, site index, sw.js or deployment
Do NOT place drafts under Pages-served directories of main
Do NOT set publishedAt or report public publication
Do NOT block next daily article because earlier visuals are pending review
validation: Review clinical safety, source freshness, intervention eligibility, statistics and references
Fetch draft back from draft branch and verify exact text
Provide GitHub draft link and visual plan separately; do not label as site link

stage2_visual.gate: After text commit, prepare a separate planned visual package mapped to exact paragraphs/sections. Generate or acquire candidate visuals independently and present previews to USER for review.
qualityChecks: anatomical accuracy: realistic 3D structures/depth, nerve/vessel safety boundaries
exam image: real plausible patient+examiner posture, hand placement, correct movement and left/right
clinical safety, no blind needle trajectory or misleading diagnostic imagery
restrictions: Candidate/rejected/unreviewed photos and figures remain ONLY in draft branch or review attachments
Never embed, upload to live Pages branch, cache, or claim visuals approved without explicit approval
Maintain review ID, version, preview, source/license, placement, approve/reject/revise status for each image
stage2_visual.approvalRule: Explicit user approval of each item or clearly defined batch is REQUIRED; silence, scheduled run, upload success, and automated quality check are not approval.

stage3_release.gate: ONLY after the user explicitly approves all required visuals and the corresponding manuscript release, promote exactly the approved revision to main.
steps: Compare draft and approved visual versions and ensure no post-approval alterations slipped in
Copy approved article fragment to articles/<id>.html, embedding approved visual files precisely at related paragraphs
Upload approved binaries to assets/briefs/<id>-*.webp/svg with rights/source captions
Update articles.json with final publishedAt (actual release time), date, type, title, keywords, publicationStatus=published
Update and bump sw.js cache version and paths while keeping PWA/offline/install/export
Validate JSON/HTML/links/image files and nonzero binary Git blobs
Commit on main; verify Pages deployment for exact commit and HTTPS article/visual URLs and cache
Set publishing-backlog.json published only after live confirmation; retain full provenance and approval records in draft branch
stage3_release.fallback: If approval is incomplete, keep draft/review pending and DO NOT release a text-only site version. If deployment fails after approval, preserve package and retry, but do not report published.

stagedWorkflow.ongoing: Continue daily research + GitHub text draft creation even if visual review backlog exists. Never auto-promote an older draft solely because a new day arrived.
stagedWorkflow.legacy: Do not retroactively unpublish earlier live articles; preserve current published IDs, assets, evidence, hashes, and existing PWA behavior.
